_note: The planning calendar: situations a household can combine, the dated rules each one brings, and quick picks (examples). Every value comes from shared/facts.json at build time; placeholders in braces are filled from the facts and the date. No date, age, count or amount is written here.

kinds.cutoff: A cut-off: a year-end or a contribution deadline

file.label: Personal returns due ({prev} tax year)
file.text: Most individuals' income tax returns for the {prev} tax year are due {date}.

balance.label: Balance owing due ({prev} tax year)
balance.text: Any balance owing on a personal return for the {prev} tax year is due {date}.

rrsp.label: RRSP contribution deadline ({prev} tax year)
rrsp.text: Contributions to an RRSP made by {date} can count for the {prev} tax year.

inst.label: Tax instalment due
inst.text: People who pay their tax by instalments pay on {value}.

se_return.label: Self-employed returns due ({prev} tax year)
se_return.text: Returns of self-employed people for the {prev} tax year are due {date}.

t2.label: Corporation's T2 return due
t2.text: A corporation's T2 return is due {value}: for a tax year that ended {prevEnd}, that is {date}.

corp_ye.label: Corporation's year-end
corp_ye.text: A corporation with a December year-end closes its tax year; its next T2 return is counted from here.

t3.label: Trust's T3 return due
t3.text: A trust's T3 return is due {value}: for a tax year that ended {prevEnd}, that is {date}.

trust_ye.label: Trust's year-end
trust_ye.text: A trust with a December year-end closes its tax year; its next T3 return is counted from here.

mature.label: RRSP maturity: the year-end for a holder turning {value} this year
mature.text: An RRSP must mature by the end of the year its holder turns {value}.

rrif_min.label: RRIF: the year's minimum paid by year-end
rrif_min.text: A RRIF pays out at least a minimum amount each year; the first minimum is paid {value}.

losses.label: A sale at a loss on the year's last day: the superficial-loss period
losses.what: a year-end sale at a loss
losses.text: A loss is superficial if the same or identical property is bought in the period from {value}, and is still owned at the end of it. For a sale on {date}, that period runs from {from} to {to}.

fhsa.label: End of the FHSA contribution year
fhsa.what: the end of the FHSA year
fhsa.text: FHSA contributions count for the year they are made in: the contribution period is {value}.

resp.label: End of the RESP grant year
resp.what: the end of the RESP grant year
resp.text: The basic grant is {value}, so each calendar year's contributions count for that year.

gifts.label: Last day for gifts claimed on this year's return
gifts.what: the last day for this year's gifts

situations.label: Files a personal return (employee or retiree)
Turning {rrsp_maturity_age} this year, with an RRSP
Sells shares at a loss near year-end

presets.label: Owner with a family trust
presets.noun: an owner with a family trust

ownDates.label: Trust deemed to dispose of its property
